newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Petrocorp to upgrade petrochem plant.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Petrocorp to upgrade petrochem plant.

text.p: Petrochemical Corp of Asia Pacific (Petrocorp) said on Thursday it would upgrade the capacity of its polypropylene plant in northern Philippines to 220,000 tonnes per year from 160,000 tonnes.
Petrocorp is majority owned by Chemical Industries of the Philippines Inc.
Petrocorp president Antonio Garcia said the high domestic demand for polypropylene prompted the company to upgrade its facility in Bataan, just north of Manila.
The plant is scheduled to begin operations next month.
He said the company had secured loans worth 610 million pesos to partly finance the expansion.
"We hope to begin the expansion of the plant by next year and we are targetting to complete the expansion phase by April 1998," Garcia told reporters.
